details:
Being able to download and load into memory parts of a world only when necessary would be helpful to get people into big worlds more quickly, and help with performance by i.e. not having other floors or their assets loaded in. The base world would consist of the spawn area and the area around it, as the world creator deems necessary.

There should be a component that marks a GameObject and its descendants as a module, which would cause it to be separated and uploaded as a separate file to the server, which would be downloaded as necessary. I think it makes sense to block nesting, so only top-level world-module components would be considered. 

Preloading a world should pre-download all of its modules, but (like Xbox games) it should have a "ready to join" point that lets you join it before it's finished downloading all of the modules. For modular worlds especially, a "Preload this world" button in World Actions in the quick menu would be nice.

Loading and unloading should be triggered via Udon and/or Soba, and Udon/Soba should be able to get the progress of the download. That way, appropriate loading screens between floors can be used, and progress bars can be shown. (Showing it as a quick menu Widget wouldn't be a bad idea either, apart from how quickly it might appear and disappear.)
title: Streamed/modular worlds
